surfaces.name: AsiBackbone Learning
surfaces.owns: Framework-neutral architecture education: tutorials, labs, runnable teaching samples, comparisons, tradeoff analysis, and educational terminology. Implementation-dependent pages are reviewed against a pinned AsiBackbone or NCAT release; Learning never defines product behavior.

surfaces.name: AsiBackbone
surfaces.owns: Package, API, runtime, and integration-boundary truth: installation, public API behavior, runtime semantics, security and cryptographic posture, exact terminology-to-API mappings, release notes, upgrade guides, and consumer verification.

surfaces.name: .NET Core Application Template
surfaces.owns: Template and generated-application truth: template options, generated configuration, middleware order, runtime contracts, the public surface, ADRs, deployment guidance, and release history.

surfaces.name: AsiBackbone Reference Application
surfaces.owns: The ordered NCAT-to-AsiBackbone integration walkthrough, its host-specific API reference, and measured integration evidence such as benchmarks, recorded per release.

surfaces.name: Organization profile and landing pages
surfaces.owns: Ecosystem positioning and navigation, the landing-page standard, organization community defaults, and the cross-repository registers: the compatibility matrix, the security assurance map, and this ownership map.

topics.title: Product fit and choosing a project

learning.note: Keeps its own fit guidance under the landing-page standard's product-fit contract and links the organization overview for choosing between projects.

asibackbone.note: Keeps its own fit guidance under the product-fit contract, including when simpler designs are enough.

ncat.note: Keeps its own "Is the template a fit?" section under the product-fit contract.

reference-application.note: States that it is an example host, not a product, and links the organization overview.

topics.note: The organization owns the cross-project choice and the shared structure of fit sections. Each project's own fit section stays canonical for its own adoption criteria.

topics.title: AsiBackbone API and runtime behavior

learning.note: Implementation-dependent pages name the reviewed AsiBackbone release and pin source links to its tag.

ncat.note: Documents only the host-owned integration seams and links AsiBackbone for package behavior.

reference-application.note: Each release records the exact package version it integrates.

topics.note: AsiBackbone's own documentation-ownership page classifies its articles; this row only routes other repositories to it.

topics.title: NCAT template options and runtime contracts

learning.note: Pages that cite NCAT behavior name the reviewed NCAT release and pin links to its tag.

asibackbone.note: Its NCAT host-validation guide is a procedure that links NCAT for generated behavior.

reference-application.note: Records its NCAT baseline as an ncat-v<version> tag; NCAT's documentation stays authoritative for baseline behavior.

topics.note: Generated applications are not modified by later NCAT releases, so a derived host's baseline is always a pinned snapshot.

topics.title: Reference Application integration sequence and measured evidence

learning.note: May describe the integration path in teaching terms and link the walkthrough for the concrete steps.

asibackbone.note: May point adopters to the walkthrough as a worked example.

ncat.note: Lists the Reference Application as a related project.

organization.note: Describes it in the profile and landing pages and links the walkthrough.

topics.note: The walkthrough is current guidance. Measured results, such as benchmarks, belong to the release that produced them and are cited by release tag.

topics.title: Framework-neutral tutorials, comparisons, and architecture explanations

asibackbone.note: Keeps short product-boundary or transition pages that route to Learning for the broader explanation.

ncat.note: Links Learning for general rationale, alternatives, and tradeoffs from its implementation articles.

reference-application.note: Links Learning for concepts instead of teaching them.

organization.note: Introduces Learning as the first stop for the patterns.

topics.note: If a page teaches an idea that stays useful without the AsiBackbone packages, it belongs in Learning.

topics.title: Educational terminology and glossary

asibackbone.note: Owns only the exact mapping from terms to API types, in its API glossary and terminology map, and links Learning for definitions.

ncat.note: Uses the terms without redefining them.

reference-application.note: Uses the terms without redefining them.

organization.note: Uses the terms without redefining them.

topics.note: Definitions live in Learning; type and namespace mappings live in AsiBackbone.

topics.title: Compatibility and version matrix

learning.note: May state the release a page was reviewed against; links the matrix for current combinations.

asibackbone.note: States its own supported line and target framework, and links the matrix for cross-project combinations.

ncat.note: States its own supported line and target framework, and links the matrix for cross-project combinations.

reference-application.note: Each release records its exact NCAT and AsiBackbone pins; the matrix records which combination it qualifies.

topics.note: Statements about another project's current version belong in the matrix. The current-version claim review below checks first-contact pages for stale copies.

topics.title: Security control ownership

learning.note: Teaches security architecture without assigning ownership of the organization's controls.

asibackbone.note: Its security and cryptographic documentation stays canonical for each control's contract; it links the map for cross-repository ownership.

ncat.note: Its security documentation stays canonical for each control's contract; it links the map for cross-repository ownership.

reference-application.note: Documents its own host controls and links the map for cross-repository ownership.

topics.note: The map records who owns each control and links each repository's documentation; it does not restate the technical contract.

topics.title: AsiBackbone release history and migration guidance

learning.note: Records which AsiBackbone release a Learning release reviewed.

ncat.note: Does not restate AsiBackbone release notes.

reference-application.note: Records each package update in its own changelog, naming the versions.

organization.note: Links release pages from the compatibility matrix.

topics.note: Release notes are historical once published. Upgrade guides are current for the version span they cover.

topics.title: NCAT release history and support lifecycle

learning.note: Records which NCAT release a Learning page was reviewed against.

asibackbone.note: Does not restate NCAT release notes.

reference-application.note: Records each NCAT baseline refresh, naming the versions.

organization.note: Links release pages from the compatibility matrix.

topics.note: Release notes are historical once published. The support policy is current guidance owned by NCAT.

topics.title: Reference Application release history

learning.note: Links the Reference Application instead of restating its releases.

asibackbone.note: Links the Reference Application instead of restating its releases.

ncat.note: Links the Reference Application instead of restating its releases.

organization.note: The compatibility matrix records each release's qualified combination with tag-pinned evidence.

topics.note: Each release is a pre-release snapshot of the walkthrough's progress.

topics.title: Learning release history and citation

asibackbone.note: Links Learning instead of restating its releases.

ncat.note: Links Learning instead of restating its releases.

reference-application.note: Links Learning instead of restating its releases.

organization.note: The compatibility matrix records each Learning release's reviewed baseline.

topics.note: Learning releases are archival and citation snapshots; they do not establish runtime compatibility or package support lines.

topics.title: Organization positioning and navigation

learning.note: Carries the shared ecosystem navigation and related-project section defined by the landing-page standard.

asibackbone.note: Carries the shared ecosystem navigation and related-project section defined by the landing-page standard.

ncat.note: Carries the shared ecosystem navigation and related-project section defined by the landing-page standard.

reference-application.note: Carries the shared ecosystem navigation and related-project section defined by the landing-page standard.

topics.note: Each project owns its own description. As the landing-page standard requires, the organization surfaces reuse those descriptions, shortened if needed, rather than inventing new claims.
